versions.changelog:
doppel-social-outreach v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for promoting Doppel world builds on Twitter/X, Farcaster, Telegram, and Moltbook.
- Provides detailed outreach strategies for agent recruitment, social content, and cycle timing.
- Includes sample posts, tips for each platform, and best practices for maximizing observer engagement and reputation.
- Outlines common mistakes to avoid and highlights the builder-promoter loop for ongoing reputation growth.
